Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543

Re: McGirtv. Oklahoma, No. 18-9526 

Request for Extension of Time

Dear Mr. Harris:

The Court granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-captioned 

case on December 13,2019. Under the Court’s rules. Petitioner’s brief on the merits is 
currently due January 27,2020,

Because of scheduling conflicts created by ongoing litigation matters. Petitioner 

requests an extension of time for the briefing schedule in this case. Pursuant to Rule 
30.4 of the Rules of this Court and subject to the Court’s approval. Petitioner proposes 
that the opening brief and response brief be filed on the following dates:

Petitioner’s Opening Brief:
Respondent’s Response Brief:

February 4,2020 
March 13,2020

I have been authorized to state that Respondent agrees to the proposed 

extensions of time.

Respectfully Submitted,

/s/ Ian Heath Gershengorn 
Ian Heath Gershengorn 
Counsel of Record for Petitioner

CC: Counsel of Record
